caption: The drawing features a wooden chair rendered in shades of light to medium brown. The chair has three horizontal slats forming the backrest, which are spaced evenly and attached to two vertical side posts that curve slightly at the top. The seat of the chair consists of a grid made from dark brown straps or cords, woven in a crisscross pattern and attached to the four wooden seat rails. The chair has four legs, which are cylindrical and straight, except for slight natural variations in thickness, and are connected by a series of horizontal stretchers near the base. The chair is depicted on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or details present in the composition. The name “Dorothy Johnson” is written near the lower right corner of the image.
title: Braided Rawhide Bottom Chair
